My maize plot is small but here in Iringa we depend on it, so I try to give it good care. I usually buy one small bag of CAN to top-dress when the maize is knee-high — not a full bag because the plot is only a small one and I also share with the beans I plant between the rows. I buy improved seed from the agro-dealer in town when I can afford it, because the local seed does not yield as well, but I do not spray chemicals — the maize here does not need it most years. I do most of the work myself with my jembe, and only call my neighbor to help for one or two days during weeding.
